comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
ROOT CAUSE CORRECTED (supersedes the outbound-churn framing). Traced the full seam:

OUTBOUND is NOT the exposed direction. diff_canonical_fields->_suppressed_by_inbound (outbound_field_diff.py:330) suppresses a mirrored field whenever local==baseline. After our own push the baseline advances to NEW (e6e9 merge_baseline overlay via synced_fields), so local(NEW)==baseline(NEW) -> outbound emits NOTHING for description regardless of the stale snapshot. Outbound cannot churn here.

The EXPOSED direction is INBOUND, LEVEL-triggered with NO baseline. Bound-field inbound goes through inbound_differ.compute_inbound_mutations -> _diff_jira_vs_local(jira_fields, local) (inbound_differ.py:97), returning any mirrored field where the CURRENT snapshot != local, consulting neither baseline nor prev_snapshot. run_differs._run_differs_inbound feeds it curr_snapshot (the JQL search snapshot) plus only an absent-key GET overlay -- no prev gating. The only protection is same-pass bidirectional suppression (3bf8), which fires only when OUTBOUND emits for the field. Since outbound is baseline-suppressed here, inbound is unguarded.

Consequence (narrow but real data-loss window): in the echo pass with a STALE post-write snapshot (description=OLD/None) while local=NEW and baseline=NEW, inbound sees jira(OLD)!=local(NEW) -> emits an inbound update -> CLOBBERS local back to OLD. The live test's _wait_until_search_reflects is a DEFENSIVE wait blocking the echo pass until the search index reflects the write (so jira==local, nothing mirrors). On the starved ephemeral DC the background reindex is unbounded -> the wait never completes -> observed 'index never reflected the pushed body within 240s' timeout. A remote!=baseline guard would NOT fix it (baseline=NEW while stale search=OLD, so OLD!=NEW still fires); the only robust fix is a lag-free read.

RESOLUTION (refined #1, correct layer): a SCOPED-pass snapshot overlay. Between bind_operation_runtime and run_differs in reconcile.reconcile_once, for each scoped local_id whose bound jira_key is present in curr_snapshot, direct-GET fresh fields via the classified seam (outbound_differ._safe_get_issue / get_issue_by_rest, immediately consistent) and MERGE the 5 mirrored scalar keys (summary/description/priority/status/assignee) into curr_snapshot[jira_key], preserving enrichment (parent/comment/issuelinks). This one overlay feeds BOTH differs AND _advance_baselines (all read ctx.curr_snapshot), so the echo pass sees jira==local -> no inbound clobber, outbound stays suppressed, baseline stays NEW. Scoped-only bounds GET volume; TRANSPORT_ERROR/DELETED leave the entry untouched (defer/existing path). Unscoped production passes get a follow-up (ambiguous-key generalization). With this, BOTH live DC tests drop _wait_until_search_reflects and the reindex entirely and read lag-free. Proven offline by a held-out oracle: stale search + fresh GET -> zero inbound clobber + baseline stays NEW (RED without the overlay: inbound emits description=OLD).

# Live DC rich-text lane: outbound echo re-diffs against stale JQL search snapshot

## Observed failure
`tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_rich_text_live.py::test_live_rich_text_renders_and_echo_is_safe`
and `::test_live_rich_text_both_sides_conflict_keeps_local` fail on the dispatched Live External
Integration run (33052311279, DC lane), both with:
`AssertionError: the index never reflected the pushed body ... within 240s (120 attempts)`.
The indexed doc shows `description: None` and `updated` stuck at the binding step.

## Corrected root cause (supersedes the "index lag / widen the wait" framing of bug 2c60)
The test's `_push_and_converge` blocks on `_wait_until_search_reflects` — waiting for the JQL
SEARCH index to reflect the pushed `description`. That guards a REAL dependency: the outbound
FIELD differ (`compute_outbound_mutations`, outbound_differ.py) diffs local tickets against the
FETCHER'S JQL-SEARCH SNAPSHOT (`fetcher.fetch_snapshot` -> `search_issues`). For a key PRESENT in
the snapshot (ours is — its key is indexed for existence via `wait_until_searchable`), the differ
compares local `description` against the SNAPSHOT's `description`, which is STALE (`None`) until
the background Lucene reindex catches up. Direct GET (`_safe_get_issue` / `get_issue_by_rest`,
immediately consistent) is used ONLY for bound-but-ABSENT keys, not bound-and-present ones. So on
the ephemeral DC — whose background reindex is UNBOUNDED (ADR 0037 s3) and, on a starved instance,
never reflects the write within any fixed budget — the echo pass re-diffs the just-pushed field as
changed and would churn, and the wait times out.

Two prior fixes (2c60: widen to 240s; then force a per-issue reindex) both targeted search
VISIBILITY. Widening cannot bound an unbounded wait, and the forced-reindex helper had NO effect
(and no observability — it no-ops silently), likely because `/rest/api/2/reindex/issue` is not an
effective synchronous foreground reindex on DC 8.17. The fix must remove the dependence on
unbounded search visibility, not chase it.

## Candidate resolutions (to be decided by investigation + history)
1. PRODUCT: outbound differ confirms a snapshot-detected field change via a bounded direct GET
   before emitting the mutation, so a stale-snapshot false-positive cannot cause churn (extends
   the existing bound-but-absent direct-GET seam to bound-and-present keys). Robust for ANY
   eventually-consistent remote.
2. HARNESS: configure the ephemeral Jira DC for synchronous/fast indexing at boot.
3. TEST: verify the landed body via a direct GET (immediately consistent) and re-express echo-
   safety so it does not depend on unbounded search visibility.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Root cause confirmed (which of 1/2/3, with history/ADR support).
- [x] Fix removes the unbounded-search-visibility dependency; a held-out test proves it with teeth.
- [x] The repo snapshot contains live rich-text echo-safety coverage: `tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_rich_text_live.py` defines `test_live_rich_text_renders_and_echo_is_safe` and `test_live_rich_text_both_sides_conflict_keeps_local`, and both tests exercise the reconciler overlay while checking rich-text echo/conflict behavior.
- [x] [non-codebase] A dispatched Live External Integration run shows the Jira DC lane GREEN and the Jira Cloud mutation lane GREEN. Run URL commented here.
      provenance: environment=github-actions external-integration.yml run 33137402410 on main at 6fe5c0d54574; principal=github-actions workflow_dispatch runner; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — dispatched run job 98740362395 concluded success for the ephemeral Jira DC lane (74 passed, none skipped), and the Jira Cloud coordinator mutation lane also concluded success.
- [x] `make lint && make typecheck && make test` green.
